basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old travel nurse based in Austin, Texas. Recently joined Reddit to connect with like-minded individuals and keep up with news and drama from around the world. I enjoy exploring new places and have a keen interest in true crime, particularly following high-profile cases. My schedule varies, but I usually browse Reddit during late-night hours. Currently single, and in my free time, I love hiking and participating in local community events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is mostly from my work as a travel nurse, which has given me a deep understanding of healthcare systems and patient care. I also have a strong interest in global news and drama, often keeping up with international events and social media trends.
